remarks: Stylish, Spacious, and Single-Level - Welcome to a rare find in one of North Stamford's sought-after neighborhoods. This true ranch-style home offers the ease of single-level living with spacious, light-filled interiors and beautiful outdoor spaces-perfect for today's lifestyle. Step into a foyer with a convenient half bath, leading into a bright living room featuring a picture window, built-ins, and gleaming hardwood floors. The adjoining dining room opens through French doors to a screened-in porch with skylights-ideal for relaxing or hosting friends. The renovated kitchen, with new microwave and dishwasher, flows seamlessly into the cozy family room with a wood-burning stove. Both spaces open to the porch and a stone patio overlooking the large, level, professionally landscaped yard-your own private oasis. The plantings are beyond beautiful. The bedroom wing includes three generously sized bedrooms and two full baths, offering comfort and privacy. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, or looking to downsize, or simply seeking low-maintenance living, this home offers timeless charm with modern updates. Enjoy peaceful living with flexible space to work, unwind, or entertain. Don't miss this rare opportunity-your forever home awaits. House is being sold 'as is.' Best and final by Tuesday July 1 at 6PM. No escalation clauses/no love letters.
